name: Kanokogi Kei
source:
He is always at Sunnyside, to the point where it is doubtful that he is really a student. He is optimistic, light-hearted, and elusive, but when the time comes, he is dependable.

His skills as a cook are first-rate, and many fans are captivated by his food.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara11-01.html]official site[/url]]
